The e=E/n stochastic approximation has unique attracting golden-ratio root φ; bounded martingale differences and a stable linear induction give almost-sure fixed-k limits. q0=(3√5−5)/10, q1=3/5, qk=q1 r^(k−1), r=(5−√5)/10, sum to one; Scheffé/truncation gives simultaneous l1 convergence, not merely finite-k convergence. Independently enumerated 1,442 incidence identities and 5,199 drift identities for all reachable labeled states through six vertices; checked mean and normalization. Infinite proof rests on exact recurrences and martingale theorem, not enumeration.
